## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, but Technology is weak and major stocks show divergent 1W/1M trends. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); style mixed, with no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary leads (+3.48% 1W), with GM (1W: +9.68% | 1M: +10.11%) and LOW (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +19.63%), both ABOVE TREND. Communication is next (+2.90%), with CHTR (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +5.59%) and CMCSA (1W: +8.38% | 1M: +11.44%), both ABOVE TREND; Real Estate ranks third (+2.85%), but constituent-level data was not supplied.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is weakest: -7.18% 1W and -9.07% 1M; QCOM (1W: -10.72% | 1M: -9.05%) and GOOGL (1W: -12.65% | 1M: -19.18%) are BELOW TREND. Energy (-1.89% 1W) and Utilities (+0.66% 1W) are the next weakest sectors by weekly performance.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: DD (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +17.42%), LLY (1W: +9.94% | 1M: +23.29%), GM (1W: +9.68% | 1M: +10.11%), CRH (1W: +9.05% | 1M: +13.16%), and CHTR (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +5.59%)—all ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors represented; Materials leads with 2 of 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: INTC (1W: -35.41% | 1M: -47.89%), NOW (1W: -29.47% | 1M: -19.78%), SHOP (1W: -14.02% | 1M: -10.95%), AMD (1W: -13.63% | 1M: -23.40%), and PANW (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -13.91%)—all BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Technology.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves: DD (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +17.42%), LLY (1W: +9.94% | 1M: +23.29%), and GM (1W: +9.68% | 1M: +10.11%), all ABOVE TREND. Major divergence is present: META (1W: +0.14% | 1M: -16.29%) is in RECOVERY, while TSLA (1W: -2.20% | 1M: +5.22%) is in CORRECTION; watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weak, with sector returns of -7.18% 1W and -9.07% 1M. NVDA (1W: -5.16% | 1M: -13.48%), GOOGL (1W: -12.65% | 1M: -19.18%), and MSFT (1W: -1.95% | 1M: -0.80%) are all BELOW TREND; stock-level sector breadth counts were not provided.

8. Financials Outlook?
Positive sector returns: +1.67% 1W and +4.22% 1M. JPM (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +2.19%), V (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +13.72%), and MA (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +14.80%) are ABOVE TREND; stock-level sector breadth counts were not provided.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Sector returns are positive (+1.98% 1W; +9.27% 1M), led by LLY (1W: +9.94% | 1M: +23.29%), ABOVE TREND. JNJ (1W: -0.95% | 1M: +5.23%) and UNH (1W: -1.45% | 1M: +6.83%) are in CORRECTION, while PFE (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +9.45%) is ABOVE TREND.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor select strength in DD (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +17.42%), LLY (1W: +9.94% | 1M: +23.29%), and MA (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +14.80%), all ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to persistent Technology weakness such as INTC (1W: -35.41% | 1M: -47.89%), BELOW TREND. Style mixed / no clear leadership; broad sector gains conflict with Technology weakness, so maintain a measured stance.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: DD (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +17.42%) and LLY (1W: +9.94% | 1M: +23.29%), both ABOVE TREND; monitor for follow-through after positive earnings-related headlines. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -35.41% | 1M: -47.89%) and AMD (1W: -13.63% | 1M: -23.40%), both BELOW TREND; watch whether weak price action persists despite AMD’s positive news sentiment.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary (+3.48% 1W; +8.98% 1M) and Materials (+2.65% 1W; +7.83% 1M), with several constituents ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Technology (-7.18% 1W; -9.07% 1M); Energy also lagged this week (-1.89% 1W), despite a positive 1M return.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not supplied. Monitor whether NVDA (1W: -5.16% | 1M: -13.48%), BELOW TREND, stabilizes; whether DD (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +17.42%), ABOVE TREND, sustains momentum; and whether META (1W: +0.14% | 1M: -16.29%), in RECOVERY, extends its short-term bounce.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
DD (+78): raised guidance and 31% EPS growth; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +17.42%), confirming the catalyst. CRH (+75): resilient revenue growth and a $6 billion buyback; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.05% | 1M: +13.16%), confirming. LLY (+50): raised-guidance discussion; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.94% | 1M: +23.29%), confirming.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
INTC (-35): news cites AMD’s AI growth and potential market-share gains; price BELOW TREND (1W: -35.41% | 1M: -47.89%), confirming weakness. CHTR (-45): price-target reduction; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +5.59%), diverging from the negative sentiment.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION remains the regime, with 9/11 sectors positive, broad leadership across four sectors, and style mixed rather than clearly Growth or Value. DD (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +17.42%) and LLY (1W: +9.94% | 1M: +23.29%) are ABOVE TREND and showing relative strength. Monitor the major 1W/1M divergences and Technology weakness, including AMD’s positive sentiment against its BELOW TREND price action (1W: -13.63% | 1M: -23.40%).
